market_workload.note: three base headers include target fence and previous checkpoint; no block advance deduplicates
market_workload.quiet_cycle_formula_cu: 152 + 60*ceil(new_blocks/window) + 20*extra_event_canonical_headers; no new block:132 with deduplicated target/checkpoint

pons_usd_assumptions: original five-second route validity and three-second tick
oracle check valid through sixty seconds; next due route refresh at sixty-six seconds
one eligible route, distinct current and retained oracle blocks
no degradation, provider fees beyond CU, processing delay, route cardinality change or restarts

portfolio.four_regimes: Pump Current + Pump Survivor + Pons Current + Pons Survivor at their own five/three-second deadlines
portfolio.larger: eight $25 original-$500 positions, two per regime; $200 aggregate basis, hypothetical admissions still require all actual governors
portfolio.one_owner: component tables; whole protection cost unknown
portfolio.scaling: sum independent components as an unshared ceiling; count shared discovery/USD/history once; exact-quantity quotes remain per owner

unknown_components: fixed infrastructure already paid without a position
baseline discovery and sustained market bytes
mandatory combined protective latency and sustained reserves
